req.title: Update unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-011 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} returns HTTP 404 when the task_id does not exist. The violation was test[3] having kind='negative' but heuristic='STC'. STC (State Transition Coverage) is a valid heuristic but must be paired with kind='boundary' or 'positive' when the schema enforces that 'negative' kind maps only to NEG or DT heuristics per the rule-based verifier. The fix is to change test[3] heuristic from 'STC' to 'NEG' (since it is testing a negative/error pathway after a state transition, the negative classification is correct and NEG is the appropriate heuristic). All other tests are preserved unchanged.

tests.name: test_put_existing_task_returns_200_with_updated_fields
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ before the PUT call
actions: POST /tasks/ with title='Original' to obtain a valid task_id
expected: Response body contains id matching created task
trace: R-TASK-011: positive path — existing task must return 200, not 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import json

client = TestClient(app)
create_resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Original", "completed": False})
assert create_resp.status_code == 201
task_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

put_resp = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "Updated"})
assert put_resp.status_code == 200
body = put_resp.json()
assert body["id"] == task_id
assert body["title"] == "Updated"
assert body["completed"] == False

tests.name: test_put_nonexistent_task_returns_404_with_detail
actions: PUT /tasks/99999 with a valid JSON body
expected: Response JSON detail contains 'Task with id 99999 not found'
trace: R-TASK-011: error pathway — non-existent task_id must yield exactly 404

assert resp.status_code == 404
body = resp.json()

tests.name: test_put_task_id_zero_returns_404
preconditions: No task with id 0 exists (auto-increment starts at 1)
actions: PUT /tasks/0 with a valid JSON body
expected: Response JSON detail contains 'Task with id 0 not found'
trace: R-TASK-011: boundary — id=0 is below the minimum valid auto-increment id; must return 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
resp = client.put("/tasks/0", json={"title": "Zero"})
assert resp.status_code == 404
body = resp.json()
assert body["detail"] == "Task with id 0 not found"

tests.name: test_put_deleted_task_returns_404
preconditions: A task is created then deleted before the PUT call
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a task and capture its id
PUT /tasks/{task_id} with a valid JSON body
expected: Response JSON detail contains the correct task id in the message
trace: R-TASK-011: negative — task transitions from existing to deleted; subsequent PUT must return 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
create_resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "ToDelete", "completed": False})
assert create_resp.status_code == 201
task_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

del_resp = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
assert del_resp.status_code == 204

put_resp = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "AfterDelete"})
assert put_resp.status_code == 404
body = put_resp.json()
assert body["detail"] == f"Task with id {task_id} not found"

tests.name: test_put_large_nonexistent_id_returns_404_not_500
actions: PUT /tasks/2147483647 with a valid JSON body
expected: Response JSON detail contains 'Task with id 2147483647 not found'
trace: R-TASK-011: boundary — maximum 32-bit integer id; must return 404 cleanly without server error
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
resp = client.put("/tasks/2147483647", json={"completed": True})
assert resp.status_code == 404
body = resp.json()
assert body["detail"] == "Task with id 2147483647 not found"

tests.name: test_put_nonexistent_task_does_not_return_200_or_201
actions: PUT /tasks/42 with all optional fields populated
trace: R-TASK-011: decision table — all combinations of missing task must map to 404 only
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
resp = client.put("/tasks/42", json={"title": "NoTask", "description": "none", "completed": False})
assert resp.status_code == 404
assert resp.status_code != 200
assert resp.status_code != 201
assert resp.status_code != 422
body = resp.json()
assert "detail" in body
assert body["detail"] == "Task with id 42 not found"
